templates.why_chosen: Two states of one hotness-tracking bitmap sit side by side, named by claim ('Retain Hotness' vs 'Cooling Down!') in red and blue rather than lettered panels, showing the before/after rule without a formal (a)/(b) frame.
templates.what_to_learn: Name the two halves of a before/after pair with a short claim phrase in colour ('Retain Hotness' / 'Cooling Down!') instead of neutral (a)/(b) letters when the labels themselves carry the mechanism's meaning; but note the weakness here: near-identical bitmap grids in both states can be told apart only by arrow colour.
